data.exact_reserve_text: The 2014 year of account declares a return on capacity of 15.3%. The 2015 year of account currently forecasts closing at a break even position.
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 was GBP 5.148m. By 31 December 2016 gross claims outstanding increased to GBP 11.788m driven primarily by an adverse 2016 underwriting event which was reserved prudently; the report does not quantify a gross prior-year (pre-2016) reserve movement. The 2014 year of account closed with a declared return on capacity (15.3%) and the 2015 year was forecasting to close at break-even, indicating mixed prior-year experience (some releases on older years but no explicit gross PYD amount disclosed).
raw_causal_phrases: The syndicate's current year loss is driven by an adverse underwriting event impacting the 2016 underwriting year.
The 2014 year of account declares a return on capacity of 15.3%.
The 2015 year of account currently forecasts closing at a break even position.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was found in the report. Opening gross claims outstanding was taken from the Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2016). A gross claims development triangle is present but the published tables in the report do not provide the full cumulative amounts at each development lag for each underwriting year (only percentages and final/current estimates for the syndicate share), preventing a reliable calculation of gross prior-year development using the triangle. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is set to null. Narrative references to prior years (2014 declared return; 2015 forecasting break-even) were recorded but not quantified. If a gross PYD number (insurance liabilities column) is required, it is not available in the disclosed notes and would require further data from the managing agent or underlying actuarial schedules.
